chapter: Williams on guitarists, family and touring
title: Uncle Simon Carney and sister Rosalie Gibson
summary: Williams says his uncle Simon Carney played with a knife and sang about a gambling man, and gives the address of his guitar-playing sister in New Orleans.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: It's mighty good. What about your uncle?

How does that go? I don't know.
